Dutiyabrahmaññasutta The Brahmin Life (2nd)

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Brahmaññañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, brahmaññatthañca. “Mendicants, I will teach you life as a brahmin and the goal of life as a brahmin. Taṁ suṇātha. Listen …

Katamañca, bhikkhave, brahmaññaṁ? And what is life as a brahmin? Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṁ—It is simply this noble eightfold path, that is: sammādiṭṭhi …pe… sammāsamādhi. right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion. Idaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, brahmaññaṁ. This is called life as a brahmin.

Katamo ca, bhikkhave, brahmaññattho? And what is the goal of life as a brahmin? Yo kho, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo—The ending of greed, hate, and delusion. ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, brahmaññattho”ti. This is called the goal of life as a brahmin.”

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
